frontier.hypothesis: The s2/s3 callee-saved rotation (11 diffs) is foreclosed under any spelling of the current whole-function RTL, so the residual is evidence that our RTL differs from the original's somewhere we have never questioned - a forensics/rederive target, not another allocation probe.
frontier.mechanism: allocno_compare is deterministic; target's own asm pins n_refs for all four callee-saved pseudos to ours, the preference axis is empty, and the flip needs 6-10 insns of extra live length inside pseudo 143's range - a region target proves contains no instructions. With identical inputs GCC must produce our map, so at least one input (flow-time insn count inside 143's range, or block/liveness structure) must differ in the original.
frontier.next_probe: Use s5/dial.sh in reverse as a WINDOW MAP: insert the 2-insn filler at each candidate site across the function and record which pseudos' live lengths move, looking for a site whose signature is '143 only'. If none exists (expected), switch modality to forensics/rederive over the regions never questioned - the rejection chain and the block_15 shift/mask computation - and re-derive them from the target asm rather than from our current C.

frontier.hypothesis: Diamond 2's remaining 8 diffs hinge on jump_chain ordering (whether block_48's label UID is below max_uid and which partners are offered for e1), not on any source spelling.
frontier.mechanism: jump.c:2012-2021 - the chain-partner loop is guarded by `INSN_UID (JUMP_LABEL (insn)) < max_uid` and walks jump_chain[] stopping at the first WIN; a jump or label created during jump optimization is invisible to the chain.
frontier.next_probe: Requires printing INSN_UID(JUMP_LABEL(insn)) and max_uid inside tools/gcc-2.7.2/jump.c, which a grind session may not edit. Route it as an operator instrumentation request (add a BB2_XJUMP_DEBUG line at jump.c:2012 printing the guard operands and the partner list); do NOT spend another session on selection-copy spellings, all four are dead.

frontier.hypothesis: The tail a0/a1 cluster (7 diffs) is the only residual whose model has never been dialled, and its hand-derived window may be as wrong as the s2/s3 one was.
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc.c qty_compare_1 pri = floor_log2(n_refs)*n_refs*size/(death-birth)*10000 with ties to the ascending qty number; pri(qty0 pointer)=4000 vs pri(qty3 Judge[] element)=5000, and qty0 < qty3 so a TIE suffices.
frontier.next_probe: Build the local-alloc analogue of s5/dial.sh using BB2_QTY_DEBUG=1 (harness tmp/grind/func_800283D0/s3/qty.sh): dial 2-insn filler between the `lh Judge($at)` and the `mult`, and separately inside qty0's span, and record the measured flip window for both directions before proposing any C. Note qty0 is a COMBINED quantity (sll producer + temp_a0 + var_a1), so the co-moving denominators must be read from the trace, not assumed.
